name: Mirai e no Method
source:
Dr. Haruka, a genius doctor, succeeded in transcending time and space and accessed Tokyo's future in the year 20XX.

However, Haruka saw that Tokyo will be in ruin.
Why has the Future Tokyo turned out like this? The protagonist stood up to restore a safe, secure, and livable Tokyo.

[Translated from the [url=https://keishicho-mirai-method.jp/method/]official website[/url]]
translation:
天才医生Haruka成功超越时空，访问了20XX年的未来东京。

然而，她看到东京已沦为废墟。
未来的东京为何会变成这样？主角挺身而出，要让东京恢复安全、安心、宜居的生活环境。

[译自[url=https://keishicho-mirai-method.jp/method/]官方网站[/url]]
